description: Save a report to run again later: a name, one report operation (reports.revenue, reports.owed, reports.quoteWinRate, reports.today, reports.week, costs.jobs), its settings, and an optional moving date range (today, this_week, last_week, this_month, last_month, last_7_days, last_30_days, last_90_days, this_quarter, last_quarter, this_year, last_year) worked out on the shop's calendar each run. Send report_id to change a saved one. Owner or office only.

params.description: The operation's own input without shop_id (and without the dates a date_range fills).

name: reports_save
